title_sq: SUPER APARTAMENT PER SHITJE TEK LIQENI I FARKES. 224,000 €
description_sq:
SUPER APARTAMENT PER SHITJE TEK LIQENI I FARKES.
224,000 €
Nje nga zonat me te kerkuara periferike te Tiranes ku mbizoteron qetesia, relaxi dhe ajri i paster ofrojme per shitje super apartament me pamje nga liqeni.
Apartamenti eshte i tipologjise 2+1 me nje planimetri kuadratike dhe te mireshfrytezuar ne cdo hapesire te saj.
Me nje orientim jug-perendim dhe pamje mahnitese nga liqeni i farkes apartamenti organizohet ne:
-Korridor shperndares
-Sallon se bashku me kendin e gatimit
-2 dhoma gjumi te bollshme
-2 tualete
-Ballkon
Si zone ne zhvillim dhe investime publike ka ne perberje pedonale rreth 6 Km perreth liqenit, piste bicikletash, korsi vrapimi dhe pjese te ndryshme relaximi dhe aktivitetesh fizike.
NJe prone ideale per banim por gjithashtu dhe per investim.
Me kontaktoni per nje vizite ne prone.
title_en: SUPER APARTMENT FOR SALE NEAR FARK LAKE. €224,000
description_en: SUPER APARTMENT FOR SALE NEAR FARK LAKE. €224,000 One of the most sought-after suburban areas of Tirana where peace, relaxation and fresh air dominates, we offer for sale a super apartment with a view of the lake. The apartment is of the 2+1 typology with a square layout and well-utilized in each of its spaces. With a south-west orientation and a stunning view of the farke lake, the apartment is organized in: - Corridor - Living room with kitchen corner - 2 spacious bedrooms - 2 bathrooms - Balcony As an area under development and public investment, there are about 6 km of pedestrian paths around the lake, bicycle tracks, running lanes and various parts of relaxation and physical activities. An ideal property for living but also for investment. Contact me for a visit to the property.
